clock_fraction_15: The quarter in the "N yli/vaille HOUR" clock frame.  "yli" governs either the
genitive or the partitive ("vartin yli kuusi" ~ "varttia yli kuusi" = 6.15),
Wiktionary (en), "yli", Finnish postposition, temporal sense and usage notes.
clock_meridiem_am: aamulla "in the morning": Finnish postposes the day-part word after the
clock ("kello 9 aamulla"), where it names the AM side of a 12-hour hour
rather than a band of its own -- the same double duty aamupäivällä already
does here and in daypart_aamu_fi.voc, which cites the surface.
clock_meridiem_night: yöllä "at night".  The Finnish night band crosses midnight (CLDR 47 fi
night1, 23:00-05:00), so the hour under it is the small-hours one: "kello 3
yöllä" is 03:00, not 15:00.  Cited in daypart_yo_fi.voc.

daypart_aamupaiva_fi: Band boundaries: Unicode CLDR 47 Day Period Rules, locale fi
Surface: aamupäivällä, the adessive of aamupäivä "forenoon" (the stretch
between mid-morning and noon, which Finnish names separately from aamu --
see the five-band note in chronologia/dayparts.py).
CLDR 47 fi names this period "aamupäivällä" in the format-wide day periods.
The same surface is the am meridiem (clock_meridiem_am.voc): the band lies
wholly before noon, so both readings agree.
